definitions.explanation: The total amount of money collected by a government through taxation. Commonly used in news and policy discussions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{税収|ぜいしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{過去最高|かこさいこう}だった。
examples.english: This year's tax revenue was the highest ever.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{税収|ぜいしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: When the economy worsens, tax revenue decreases.

examples.japanese: {税収|ぜいしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{国債|こくさい}→国債：12016_kokusai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{示|しめ}された→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: A policy was announced to issue government bonds to make up for the shortfall in tax revenue.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax) and {収|しゅう} (income, revenue). An abbreviation of ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧.

Frequently appears in news reporting about government budgets and fiscal policy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税収|ぜいしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ (tax revenue increases)
- {税収|ぜいしゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}む→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧ (tax revenue drops)
- {税収|ぜいしゅう}⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧ (tax revenue shortfall)
- {過去最高|かこさいこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{税収|ぜいしゅう} (record-high tax revenue)
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{税収|ぜいしゅう} (national tax revenue)
